name: Small-scale Ecosystem Grants
summary: Grants for small on-the-ground projects of two years or less that restore wetlands, riparian areas, fish habitat, forests or grasslands, or conserve species of concern, in the Columbia Basin of British Columbia. Intake is continuous until funds run out.

amount.note: Typical maximum Trust funding per project, not counting wage subsidy

status.quote: Applications are accepted on a first-received, first-served basis and are assessed as they come in and continue until all funding for the program has been committed.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include registered non-profits, local governments and First Nations in the Columbia Basin Trust region

geography.quote: Eligible applicants include registered non-profits, local governments and First Nations in the Columbia Basin Trust region

access.quote: Contact ecosystems@ourtrust.org to enquire about your project. Eligible projects will be invited to apply and sent an application form.

window.quote: The Small-scale Ecosystems Grants accepts inquiries and applications on a continuous basis throughout the year.

amount.quote: The typical maximum amount of Trust funding for any one project is $80,000, not including wage subsidy funding.

co_finance_required.quote: Up to 80% of total project costs can be requested from the Trust.
